name: starryear-threefold-memory
title_zh: 照片分三层：记忆碎片、证据原件、心情路线图
tagline_zh: 上层把照片重组成大块不规则碎片的视觉记忆，中层原片不动当证据，下层把路线、方向、情绪画成一张记忆地图。
tagline_en: Top: the photo recomposed as large fragments of visual memory. Middle: the untouched photo as evidence. Bottom: route, direction and mood drawn as a memory map.
desc_en: Top: the photo recomposed as large fragments of visual memory. Middle: the untouched photo as evidence. Bottom: route, direction and mood drawn as a memory map.
why_zh: 它规定每一条路线、节点、碎片、图标、配色都必须从这张照片推出来，不许写死地点，也不许套装饰性的星座。
why_en: Every route, node, fragment, pictogram and palette must derive from this photo — no hard-coded places, no decorative constellations.
limit_zh: 只吃一张锁定的照片，三层等高竖排，版式不可改。下层的「记忆地图」是从照片推的空间信号，不是真地图，别拿它导航。仓里 3 个 SKILL.md，这是主件。
limit_en: One locked photo, three equal stacked panels, fixed layout. The map is a spatial signal, not navigation.
title_en: Photo in 3 layers: memory fragments, raw evidence, mood map
